newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains still drifting lower, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains still drifting lower, trade thin.

text.p: UK cash grains continued to drift lower on Friday, but trade remained thin.
"There is still a lack of sellers in the market as they hold out for higher prices, but I can't see that happening," said one broker.
Only one trade was reported in the fob market when old crop June fetched 88 stg a tonne ex-east coast ports.
Brokers on the delivered market said it was a case of being in the right place at the right to find business on a very thin market.
Feed wheat in East Anglia was trading around one stg down at 87 stg for June.
In the Avon range feed barley traded at 87 stg for June while 11 percent protein milling wheat traded at 108 stg in the Tilbury area. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
